derivation: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and the same as H5881 (עֵינָן); village of springs;

words.word: of it shall be at hazarenan

occurrences.text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar–enan: this shall be your north border.
words: of it shall be at Hazarenan

occurrences.text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar–enan to Shepham:

Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar–enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
